results.title: US Open Day 7: Shocks and Triumphs on the Court
results.description: The US Opens seventh day unfolded with both expected triumphs and surprising turnarounds Kazakh second seed Elena Rybakina dispatched Ukraines Yuliia Starodubtseva while Japans Naomi Osaka moved onwards overcoming a challenging match against Belgiums Elise Mertens
